fields.director_notes:
Pipeline (TimeLine, in order): geo -> ground -> direct -> verify -> art -> assets -> timing -> render -> mix -> package.
geo: OpenStreetMap via Overpass, 16 stations, 17.739 km of Yellow Line, 3D city.
ground: evidence pack from Wikidata, Wikipedia and a curated facts file, 307 sources.
direct: MiniMax M3.1 flash (minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash) wrote treatment, stops, script, on-screen text, image prompts and music prompt.
verify: M3.1 flash checked every claim against the excerpts it cites; repair rounds rewrote failing scenes.
art: M3.1 flash wrote landmark painting prompts.
assets: voice, images, music. timing. render: three.js 3D map in the system browser via playwright-core. mix: ffmpeg. package: this entry.
Every creative decision and every line of the script came from MiniMax M3.1 flash via SandBase; code only checks and executes.
Voice: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD (minimax/speech/2.8/hd), 14 narration clips, custom voice made with MiniMax Voice Design (minimax/voice-design), chosen by the maker.
Images: Google Nano Banana 2.1 (google/nano-banana-2.1), 11 paintings (6 scene, 5 landmark) plus cover.
Music: MiniMax Music 2.6 (minimax/music/2.6), instrumental, 1 track.
Tools/data: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via Overpass, Wikidata, Wikipedia, NASA Earth Observatory Black Marble for the opening globe, three.js, playwright-core with the system's Edge or Chrome, ffmpeg.
M3.1 flash director calls: 19 (direct 6, verify 12, art 1; 3 retries after code checks; 5 replayed from cache).
M3.1 flash calls in the whole cost ledger: 74, 1.21M prompt and 0.41M completion tokens, $0.43.
